summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] union member; rich/control.py adds the format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(); rich/_windows_renderer.py calls term.set_title with the control's second item; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(), which returns True when the terminal is present and False otherwise; CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200; tests were added in test_control.py, test_windows_renderer.py (Windows only), and test_console.py (skipped on Windows). Nothing was run or formatted with Black, and nothing was committed.
